Surfsilk Kaimana 20" fabric: 53% partially recycled REPREVE polyester, 35% partially recycled polyester, 12% spandex. Waists 28–40 on all 50, 42 on 45, 44 on 43.

notes: Homepage title 'Quiksilver | Surf & Snowboard Clothing'; meta 'Created by surfers since 1969'. known_for from the title.

Shipping page: Free Ground Shipping over $125 for the contiguous US; Standard 5–7 business days $10.00; Hawaii/Alaska $25.00; Canada Economy $58.00 CAD; no P.O. boxes or APO/FPO; wetsuits excluded from free shipping.

Refund policy: '30 day Return Period' from the original ship date (45 days for Nov 18–Dec 25 orders); '$7.50 restocking fee applied to all returns & exchanges'; exchanges and prepaid labels US only. Same terms, wording and store layout as billabong.com.

Wikipedia (Quiksilver): founded 1969 in Torquay, Victoria by Alan Green and John Law; now based in Huntington Beach, California; Authentic Brands Group bought Boardriders in 2023; after the 2025 Liberated Brands bankruptcy the North American men's license went to O5 Apparel.
